text: {"lessons":["Selling B, D, and E for gains and later buying them again reminds me not to treat a realized profit as a reason to exit or a price move as a reason to re-enter; each trade needs a forward-looking rationale.","I should judge holdings by their expected role and risk in the portfolio, not by average cost or the discomfort of realizing a loss.","With unpredictable prices and infrequent account checks, I should avoid unnecessary trades, maintain diversification, and make decisions based on a deliberate plan rather than short-term fluctuations."]}
